$comment: Every product image on the site, from the app's own captures: ~/Movies/Wealthit Website/build-26/screens, made by the iOS session on 23 October 2026 from the app at commit e3a5dbd (TestFlight build 26) on the iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator — 1320 x 2868 px = 440 x 956 pt — with the app's sample data. `screens` are whole screens, shown in a phone. `crops` are rectangles in points cut from a whole screen. `cuts` are pieces cut elsewhere: tap-card and widgets from the App Store posters 03 and 09, which draw Tap to Record's Lock Screen card and two Home Screen widgets from the app's real code (media-src/app). Nothing is redrawn or retouched. See docs/SCREENSHOTS.md.
